name: NETHER WORLD
source:
The man is walking on the path of hell, because he wants to attend his sister’s wedding. The pieces of his life are money in nether world. Please help him with your choices.

[From [url=https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/44/nether-world/]Ludum Dare website[/url]]

Made for Ludum Dare 44.
translation:
这个男人正走在地狱之路上，因为他要去参加他姐姐的婚礼。他的生命碎片在阴间都是金钱。请帮助他做出选择。

[来自[url=https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/44/nether-world/]Ludum Dare网站[/url]]

专为Ludum Dare 44打造。
